description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news app, managing tab navigation among different news categories and handling display of loading/error states.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that creates a Scaffold with a tabbed interface to navigate through different news categories. It includes an AppBar with a navigation button to the SavedNewsScreen and dynamically displays content based on the app state.

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A simple data class representing a news category tab with a title and associated widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for HomeScreen, including AppBar, TabBar, and TabBarView with error handling and loading states.
